0.why: Oxcart.cpp:104 takes getChannels() on this input and Oxcart.cpp:113 reads channel ch with getPolyVoltage; Oxcart.cpp:114 clamps the knob-plus-input sum to -4 to 6, so a negative voltage lowers the pitch
Oxcart.cpp:105 sets this output's channel count from the pitch input

comment: The wave is -tanh(phase) over a phase period of 4 (Oxcart.cpp:110, :176) with the minBLEP residual added. The output is multiplied by 6 at Oxcart.cpp:153; a comment there records that 4.5 would be the correct figure for the current DC blocker and that 6 was kept for backward compatibility, so this module runs about a third hotter than the maker intends.
